title: Torrent Builder batch.yaml
description: Torrent Builder batch configuration file. Each job in `jobs` creates one torrent; jobs run in parallel with `workers` threads. NOTE: the per-job config field definitions (trackers, private, piece_size, etc.) are intentionally duplicated from presets.json so each schema stays self-contained and portable across editors/validators. Keep the two copies in sync.

version.description: Batch file format version. Only 1 is supported.

workers.description: Number of parallel workers. Each worker internally spawns hashing threads, so total threads ≈ workers × hashing_threads.

preset_file.description: Path to a shared preset file applied to all jobs.

rules_file.description: Path to a shared tracker rules file applied to all jobs.

output_dir.description: Default output directory for jobs that do not specify an absolute `output`.

jobs.description: Ordered list of jobs to execute.

job.description: A single batch job. The four job-specific keys (path, output, preset, fail_on_season_warning) plus any of the per-torrent config fields below are accepted. All config fields are optional and override preset/built-in defaults.

output.description: Output .torrent path. The `.torrent` extension is appended automatically if missing. Relative paths resolve against output_dir.

preset.description: Name of a preset (from preset_file) to apply.

fail_on_season_warning.description: Fail the job if a TV season pack has missing episodes.

items.description: Tracker announce URL. Must be http://, https://, or udp://. Leading/trailing whitespace is rejected.
Web seed URL. Must be http://, https://, or udp://. Leading/trailing whitespace is rejected.

source.description: Source field embedding (e.g. a tracker tag like "PTP").

piece_size.description: Piece size in KB (e.g. 4096 = 4MB). Must be one of the enum values (16, 32, … 32768). Mutually exclusive with target_piece_count.

target_piece_count.description: Desired number of pieces; piece size is calculated from content size. Mutually exclusive with piece_size.

creator.description: Created-by field. Overrides the default "Torrent Builder". Set no_creator: true to omit.

creation_date.description: Whether to embed creation date. Set no_date: true to omit.

no_creator.description: Explicitly omit the creator field. Takes precedence over `creator`.

no_date.description: Explicitly omit the creation date. Takes precedence over `creation_date`.

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude. Supports *, **, and ?.

include_patterns.description: Glob whitelist: when non-empty, only files matching a pattern are kept (matching also overrides exclude patterns). Supports *, **, and ?.

builtin_excludes.description: Apply built-in system-file exclusions (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db, etc.).

allOf.description: piece_size and target_piece_count are mutually exclusive.
